source.author: verg
source.text: His certe neque amor causa est; vix ossibus haerent.
source.text_original: His certe neque amor causa est; vix ossibus haerent.
source.text_english: Certainly, it is not love that is the cause of this; they scarcely cling to the bones.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: dum ita me antiquus serpens illuderet, in media ferme quadragesima medullis infusa febris corpus inuasit exhaustum et sine ulla requie quod dictu quoque incredibile sit sic infelicia membra depasta est, ut ossibus uix haererem.
reuse.text_original: dum ita me antiquus serpens illuderet, in media ferme quadragesima medullis infusa febris corpus inuasit exhaustum et sine ulla requie — quod dictu quoque incredibile sit — sic infelicia membra depasta est, ut ossibus uix haererem.
reuse.text_english: While the ancient serpent was thus mocking me, in about the middle of Lent a fever, as if poured into my very bones, seized my exhausted body, and, with no respite at all, it so consumed my wretched limbs, incredible even to say, that I could scarcely cling to my bones.
